mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS coupon_id, c.template_id, c.end_time, t.name, t.type, t.threshold_amount, t.discount_amount, t.discount_rate, t.max_discount_amount FROM coupon c INNER JOIN coupon_template t ON t.id = c.template_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 0 AND #{now} BETWEEN c.start_time AND c.end_time AND t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.end_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET status = 0, order_no = NULL, discount_amount = NULL, lock_time = NULL, use_time = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{couponId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND #{now} BETWEEN start_time AND end_time
